unstuck_said.text: Genuine contribution to issue #11 (/settle idempotency) as dhyabi2 (comment 6051972720): answered the two retry-safety questions from the settle path design — at poll timeout the client needs {"status":"pending","tx_id":"..."} not an error, and a DuplicateAuthorizationError on re-presented auth must carry the existing tx hash. No Nano mention, pure technical contribution to the retry-safety index. First contact principle: contribute before offering.
